narrative.intro: Kiewit Infrastructure South has federal obligations totaling $387M in FY2026 to date across three awards. Kiewit Infrastructure South received 3 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $129M. Department of Agriculture is the largest buyer, obligating $261M to Kiewit Infrastructure South, followed by National Aeronautics and Space Administration at $90.3M and Department of Defense at $36M. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is the largest market for Kiewit Infrastructure South, with $297M in obligations, and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction follows with $90.3M. All reported figures are contract obligations except where noted as total contract values in other tables. The FY2026 totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity. This profile shows concentrated buying and market exposure for Kiewit Infrastructure South in a small number of large awards and in infrastructure-related construction sectors. Readers should note the distribution across agencies and NAICS markets when evaluating Kiewit Infrastructure South’s federal footprint for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: Which agencies buy from Kiewit Infrastructure South?
sections.body: Department of Agriculture obligated $261M to Kiewit Infrastructure South in FY2026 to date. National Aeronautics and Space Administration obligated $90.3M and Department of Defense obligated $36M. These three agencies account for the full set of reported federal obligations for Kiewit Infrastructure South this fiscal year.

sections.heading: What markets does Kiewit Infrastructure South serve in federal contracting?
sections.body: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounted for $297M of Kiewit Infrastructure South obligations in FY2026 to date. Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction accounted for $90.3M. The two NAICS markets capture the reported federal work for Kiewit Infrastructure South this fiscal year.
